title: Introduce sequential probe compositor and adaptive cutover allocator
author: Priya Natarajan
body: Motivation: improve canary probe efficiency and reduce probe-induced noise during rollouts by composing sequential probes and allocating cutover budgets adaptively based on recent telemetry. This change introduces a Sequential Probe Compositor that stitches short-window synthetic probes into prioritized sequences to better surface phase-aligned regressions, and an Adaptive Cutover Allocator that computes per-rollout cutover budgets using traffic-conditioned stability scores and SLO-weighted credits. Key goals: lower false positives from probe collisions, preserve signal fidelity for tail latency, and enable safer gradual cutovers for large traffic shifts. Implementation notes: compositor merges probe windows across latency, throughput and error-rate signals; it maintains ordering and backpressure semantics so probes do not overload healthy replicas; allocator uses EWMA of percentile deltas and a stability-credit ledger to decide cutover percentages and cooldowns; both components expose Prometheus metrics and tracing hooks for downstream canary evaluators. Testing & rollout: added unit tests for sequence stitching and allocator math, integration harness that replays historical traffic traces to validate conservative/default budgets, and e2e traffic-driven scenarios validating fallback to existing sentinel policy. Checklist: [x] design doc referenced (ENG-2201); [x] unit + integration tests; [x] telemetry & dashboards; [x] docs/recipes update; [x] staged rollout to staging clusters. Related: ENG-2201, ENG-2283. This PR is a functional addition to perf-canary and is backwards-compatible with existing probe configs; default behavior remains unchanged until opt-in is enabled on rollout policies.

review_comments: Liam Carter: Nice direction — can you clarify how the compositor handles overlapping probes from different cohorts? Suggest adding a determinism test for ordering.
Priya Natarajan: Added deterministic ordering test and documented tie-breaker (cohort priority then timestamp).
Aria Gomez: CI flaked on replay harness (timeout) — looks like the test fixture needs a longer deadline.
Priya Natarajan: Increased harness timeout and added retries; re-ran CI; see updated CI run below.
Marta Ivanova: Minor nit: allocator math uses EWMA window 60s by default — please make configurable per-deployment.
Priya Natarajan: Exposed ewma_window and stability_threshold as config flags with safe defaults.
Chen Wu: Approve after addressing race and adding metrics; verified dashboards in staging.
release_notes: Add Sequential Probe Compositor and Adaptive Cutover Allocator: opt-in canary features that reduce probe noise and compute conservative cutover budgets based on recent telemetry; metrics and recipes added to docs.
